units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:5">Ab. Zar. IV, 5</cite> <he>פְּחָסָהּ אע״פ שלא חיסרה</he> if he smashed the face of the idol, although he did not lessen its substance.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7">Lev. R. s. 7</cite>, beg. <he>שהיה אהרן נוטל קורנס ופוֹחֲסוֹ בפניהם</he> (not <he>קרבנם</he>) Aaron took a hammer and smashed it (the golden calf) in their presence; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 479">Yalk. ib. 479</cite> <he>שהיה הקכ״ה … ופיתחו</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 946:2-6">Yalk. Prov. 946</cite> <he>הקב״ה … את הפנקס ופותחו</he> (corr. acc., or <he>ופיֹחֲתוֹ</he>); a. e.

senses.gloss: (of liquids) to dash into, to cause commotion, stir up.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 72b:2">Ab. Zar. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>פְּחָסַתּוֹ צלוחיתו</he> his bowl, which was filled to the brim through a syphon, pressed the wine back into the tube and thus stirred the whole mass up; ib. 56ᵇ (I may also say) <he>פחסתו בורו</he> the vat into which the net (<cite ref="C01245"><he>גַּרְגּוּתְנִי</he></cite>) was thrown set the wine in commotion.—Chald. v. <cite ref="Q00485"><he>פְּחַשׁ</he></cite>.
